patch:
Index: README.md
===================================================================
--- README.md	
+++ README.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+## 一键安装push命令，到~/.local/bin中
+
+```bash
+curl -fsSL https://gitee.com/zefyone/tools/raw/master/install.sh | bash
+```
\ No newline at end of file

Index: install.sh
===================================================================
--- install.sh	
+++ install.sh	
@@ -1,14 +1,14 @@
 #!/bin/bash
 set -euo pipefail
 
 # 安装智能Git推送工具
 echo "========================================"
 echo "🚀 安装 push 到 ~/.local/bin"
 echo "========================================"
 
 mkdir -p ~/.local/bin
-cp -f push.sh ~/.local/bin/push
+curl -fsSL https://gitee.com/zefyone/tools/raw/master/push.sh -o ~/.local/bin/push
 chmod +x ~/.local/bin/push
 
 echo -e "\n✅ 安装成功！"
 echo "👉 使用方法: 在任何仓库输入:  push"
